closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, magnesium, and easy to sprinkle into meals for a real upgrade, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low omega 3, and low fibre. It is good for bone health, immune support, and muscles and strength sports because magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, and the protein section supports repair and maintenance.
